notes.title: Update 1.1.0 Live!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/iNk3zMD.gif[/img]
[h1]Animal collectors![/h1]

We've heard your requests and are happy to announce that Update 1.1.0 is now live and adds some great controller customization options to Uurnog Uurnlimited!
[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30494326/468bb33f3c673cb1d26e88352fa49e8f862c257c.png][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30494326/76d4cd712696c8e67af669517aefe73ce873fd1e.png[/img][/url]

[b]You'll be able to re-map the controls for either gamepad or keyboard.[/b]

Enjoy! 

[i]PS: Have you found the Uurnog yet?[/i]

notes.title: Introducing Uurnog Uurnlimited – Uurndoubtedly the Most Uurnpredictible Platformer in the Uurniverse
notes.content:
[b]Next project from Raw Fury and developer Nifflas coming to Switch and Steam this fall![/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30494326/236196f122bcf5ed1d9355865000179b3745e1c2.jpg[/img]

Hello world, meet [b]Uurnog Uurnlimited[/b]—the next game to be published by Raw Fury and developed by the incredibly talented Nifflas! It is, with absolute certainty, the quirkiest game we have signed to date (and that says a lot considering we published [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/437570/GoNNER/]GoNNER[/url] <3) and the uurnbelievable amount of puns you can make out of its name was at least 20% of the reason we told ourselves WE NEED TO BE A PART OF THIS NIFFLAS PLEASE PLEASE PLEASE.

[h1][b]Announce Trailer:[/b][/h1]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TrBjWPEQ0js
[h1]This game has everything:[/h1]
• Animal stealing… err, collecting
• Algorithmic music that adapts the melody and more to gameplay
• Local co-op where your friend plays as an adorable dog on a leash
• Just want to emphasize how cute this dog is by adding another line about it
• Really (still talking about the dog)
• Boss fights, multiple endings, a Save Room that is not what you think, and more!
• A Steamworks level editor (post-launch) 

[b]Uurnlimited???[/b]
You may have seen Uurnog before, the original version was released as a Humble exclusive. This is the [b]Uurnlimited[/b] version, which is an extended edition with a bunch of new features (co-op, additional endings, boss fights, and level editor) and will mark the first time the world of Uurnog will be available to Switch and Steam users!

[b]Uurnog Uurnlimited[/b] will be available later this year! The wait won’t be too uurnbearable, promise.
 
[h1]For more info on [b]Uurnog Uurnlimited[/b]:[/h1]
Official site: uurnog.com
Steam group: http://steamcommunity.com/groups/rawfurygames
Join us on Discord: discord.gg/rawfury
